description.value: El Furniture Warehouse is a bustling pub and restaurant in the heart of downtown Victoria, located steps from the Inner Harbour on Yates Street. The space features exposed brick, roll-up windows, and dog-friendly street-side seating, giving it a relaxed, welcoming character. Part of a Canadian multi-location chain, the Victoria outpost is a well-reviewed neighbourhood staple serving pub food with late-night hours and easy takeout.
